newsitem.title: USA: Loral plans to own 100 pct Space Systems.
newsitem.headline: Loral plans to own 100 pct Space Systems.

text.p: Loral Corp said on Monday it made a strategic decision to increase its ownership in Space Systems/Loral to 100 percent.
It already owned 51 percent of Space Systems, after buying an 18.3 percent interest from the Lehman Partnerships in August, Loral said.

The company said it recently made offers to Aerospatiale, Alcatel, OASA and Finmeccanica SPA to acquire their respective 12.25 percent ownership interests in Space Systems/Loral, also in exchange for Loral common stock.

"Space Systems/Loral's outstanding record of financial performance and technical reliability makes it an excellent investment given the huge demand and undercapacity throughout the satellite industry," said Bernard Schwartz, chairman and chief executive officer.
